cap: Each breast cancer drug has one defining feature. Tamoxifen blocks the estrogen receptor in breast but stimulates the endometrium, raising endometrial cancer and clot risk; raloxifene spares the endometrium. Aromatase inhibitors work alone only after menopause, because an active ovary overcomes the block. Trastuzumab causes reversible cardiotoxicity from lost HER2 survival signals, unlike the permanent damage of anthracyclines, and PARP inhibitors kill BRCA-deficient cells.
